messages:
Priya (Marketing): Need a compact "knife-edge" battle packet for Wed webinar. Goal: 1) two crisp benchmark headlines vs Cloud APIs 2) three SDR rebut templates for infra/procurement 3) routing note for high-intent leads.

Nate (Product Marketing): Love the term. Let's aim for one metric-forward headline + one story headline. Metric-forward = "30% lower effective per-token cost at production QPS". Story = "Ship reliable LLM features across hosted, dedicated, and private ops."

Mateo (Eng-ML): Quick sanity: our bench (chat seq=128, mixed prompt lengths) shows 22-35% lower cost_per_1k after batching+kv caching vs CloudAPI-prod; p95 tail is ~20-40ms tighter on typical traffic. Will attach numbers.

Ivy (Field): For procurement: need two short rebut templates. One on governance (KMS, VPC, audit logs), one on ops risk (rollouts + regional fallbacks). Keep them <25 words.

Sam (Sales): Draft SDR rebut templates:
- Governance: "We support customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, and audit logs for compliance requests."
- Ops risk: "Built-in rollouts and model fallback keep latencies within SLOs during outages."
- Cost: "Batching & cache yield measurable unit-econ improvements vs passthrough endpoints."

Lila (Growth): Landing copy tests: A) "Predictable inference economics, not surprise bills" B) "Run LLMs where you need them: cloud, dedicated, or on-prem". Ill A/B and report. Also suggest CTA: "See a live failover demo".

Mateo (Eng-ML): Demo checklist for live webinar: 1) show p95 tail before/after batching (plot) 2) trigger region fallback -> show quantized model serving 3) show logs with audit event for KMS key access. Keep demo <5 minutes.

Priya (Marketing): Routing note: high-intent leads (trial+ >50 req/s) go to Dedicated motion SDR queue; trial+ with security questions route to Field AE. Lila, can you add a hidden form field to capture "SLA priority" so we auto-route?

Lila (Growth): Yup. I'll add dropdown: "Standard / Dedicated / Private / Compliance review" and wire to LeadRouter. Also add a hidden utm=knifeedge-battle so we can track conversions.

Nate (Product Marketing): Battlecard bullets to finalize: top claim, metric, 3 SDR snips, 2 procurement bullets, demo steps, routing rule. I'll compile and assign owners.

ops-bot: Reminder: Webinar collateral freeze on 2026-07-10 23:59 UTC.

Priya (Marketing): Great — if owners can drop final lines + bench CSV by EOD Tuesday Ill assemble the packet and the webinar slide deck. Thanks! :rocket:
